title: fix(objectql): a following amount whose parent code field is no longer served is refused with a message that says so
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_
Fixes #33888
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:子表金额跟随父记录币种、而父对象已不再提供该币种字段(提供它的扩展包被停用或卸载)时,写入仍以 `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400 拒绝,但提示改为说明"父对象不再提供该字段",并在注册表仍记得时点名被停用的包。
- 为什么改:旧提示说"父记录币种为空,请先写入币种",而那个字段已经不存在,照做只会得到另一个错误。
- 风险与回滚:只改提示文案;错误码、状态码、`field`、`amountField` 不变,币种字段确实为空时的原文案一字不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts` 的 `parentCodeFieldServingOf` 与 `codeRequiredMessage` 新分支;再看 `record-currency-guards.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/record-currency-guards.test.ts -t "no longer served"`,预期 2 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`RecordCurrencyCodeRequiredError` gains a third case for a following amount (`currencyField: 'MASTER_DETAIL.CODE'`): the parent object, as served at the write, declares no field under the code segment. Before, that case fell into the blank-code text, which asks for a code to be written into the field that is not there. Now the refusal reads, for the measured disable path:

> Insert on 'suite_line' was REFUSED: 'amount' holds an amount in its parent record's currency (currencyMode: 'record', following 'invoice.currency_code' through the master_detail 'invoice'), and 'suite_invoice' does not serve a field 'currency_code' (the package 'com.test.supplier' that contributed it is disabled); the amount has no code to follow until that field is served again, or leave 'amount' empty. The row was not written.

- **Package clause.** The registry keeps a disabled package's `extend` contribution, so on the disable path the package is named. An uninstall removes the contribution, so there the clause is the card's generic one: "(a package that contributed it may be disabled or uninstalled)".
- **Where the fact comes from.** The path pair is resolved in `recordCurrencyPairs` / `recordCurrencyPathOf` from the child's own field map only, so the guard cannot know what the parent serves. `assertRecordCurrencyCodes` takes one new optional argument, a `ParentCodeFieldServing` reader. `parentCodeFieldServingOf(registry)` builds it from `getObject` (the served fold, a disabled extension left out), `getObjectContributors` and `isPackageDisabled`. The four write-side callers pass it: insert, by-id update, predicate update and the `validate()` preview, in `engine-insert.ts`, `engine-update.ts` (two sites) and `engine-validate.ts`. It is asked only after a pair is refused, about the first refused pair, so the accepted write path reads nothing new.
- **Unchanged.** `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400, `field`, `fields`, `amountField`, and the full text for a served code field that is blank. A parent object that is not served at all keeps today's text. The guard is not exported from the package entry, so the published API surface does not move.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts` (the shared harness for this guard) gains one top-level describe on the measured fixture: `billing` owns `suite_invoice` and `suite_line`, `supplier` extends `suite_invoice` with `currency_code`, `suite_line.amount` follows `invoice.currency_code`.

- disable path: after `disablePackage(supplier)` a child insert is refused `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400 with `field` `invoice.currency_code`, the message carries the not-served clause naming the disabled package, and does not carry "has a blank". The same test then uninstalls the supplier and asserts the generic package clause.
- CONTROL: under a served but blank parent code, the message equals today's full text.

Ablation (committed fix first, mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restored the blob to HEAD and found `git diff HEAD` empty): replacing the reader call `parentCodeServing?.(path.master, path.code)` with `undefined` turns the disable-path test red and leaves the blank-text CONTROL green.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no` confirmed against the ADR-0112 ledger row for `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`): it records the code and status, not the text.
- The lifecycle doors' own behaviour stays parked on #33628 (seat ruling D). This PR changes only what the write's refusal says.
